1. $z^{(c)}_{i,j}=\sum_{c',u,v} K^{(c)}_{c',u,v}\,h^{(c')}_{i+u,j+v}+b^{(c)}$ (notation may vary).
2. Local connections + tied weights restrict a dense MLP to a much smaller, vision-shaped parameter set.
3. Replaces the block by its maximum value (downsample / local summary).
4. The forward map is still a differentiable composition of convolutions, activations, and pooling; chain rule applies to the shared $K$.
5. Variable-length sequences / strong temporal order with shared dynamics over time (RNNs).
